query:
SELECT a.id, p.name as paciente, u.name as terapeuta, a.startTime, a.endTime, a.therapyType, a.status 
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p ON a.patientId = p.id
JOIN users u ON a.therapistUserId = u.id
WHERE a.startTime >= '2026-02-07 00:00:00' AND a.startTime < '2026-02-08 00:00:00'
ORDER BY a.startTime;
